rows.title: PDF: with the Skills style set to Stacked or Tags, a skill group's category heading (and Stacked's thin rule under it) can be left alone at the bottom of a page while that group's skills move to the next page
rows.summary: Now: in Skills styles Stacked, Tags and Bars a group's category is an unbreakable block that keeps the first lines of its skills on its page (minPresenceAhead, three entry lines in the main column, 30 pt in the Sidebar's side column, SPACER giving it the previous sibling it needs), so the category moves to the next page with its skills instead of ending a page alone. This holds in the main column (any Grids) and in the Sidebar's dark column. Word's Stacked category paragraph now has keepNext. Bars had the same orphan, so it got the same keep. Fail-first: all 6 subtests fail without the fix and pass with it.

issues: No defect in c09d9a24. It fixes the root cause: the Bars/Stacked/Tags category is now an unbreakable View with minPresenceAhead, led by SPACER (entry() in the main column, an explicit SPACER in the Sidebar's groups). react-pdf clamps the presence to the group's own later siblings, so a category with no skills never forces a break and the keep never reaches past its group. The wrappers add no height (SPACER is 0 pt; the Text's marginBottom moves inside its wrapper), and Tags' alignSelf stretch keeps a centred category centred. SkillsSection and SideSkills are the only Skills renderers, so no other template path is affected. Word: keepNext on the Stacked category only; Tags and Bars in Word are one inline paragraph and cannot orphan.

Coverage gap (fixed in the test only): the fix changed the Sidebar's Bars and the main column in Grids, but the test swept neither. Added 'Sidebar's side column, Bars' (fails without the fix, passes with it) and 'Classic, Stacked in two Grids' (a regression guard: passes both ways, since the grid row keep already holds a Grids row's categories). The sweep's line matcher now reads a Grids row's categories printed side by side on one line.

Run 36637125643 on d088c9e5: failfirst for c09d9a24 green (fail 7 of 8 without the fix, all 8 pass with it; the Grids guard is the one that passes both ways), tests and lint green.
